{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–13 (2002–2007 PDF slips), including [[Defensive Shields]]. It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 13]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS13''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–13. [[Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost|Virtual Set 13]] (Remote Outpost) has official text as of 22 July 2007.<ref name="vc13">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards13.pdf VirtualCards13.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks</ref><ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref><ref name="vs13">[[Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost]]</ref> The pool includes [[Defensive Shields]] (between original Virtual Sets 11 and 12). [[Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational|Virtual Set 14]] is dated 23 December 2007, after this cutoff. The short name '''POVS13''' redirects here.

The [[2007 World Championship]] (Chicago, 5–7 October 2007) was played in this pool.<ref name="dl2007">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2007-decklists/ 2007 Decklists], starwarsccg.org</ref>
